<design>
# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

## Traceability

| FR-1 | POST /api/links | com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |
| FR-2 | GET /{code} | com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |

| FR-7 | GET /api/links/{code}/analytics | com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |
| FR-8 | POST /api/links | com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator | — |
| FR-9 | POST /api/links | com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |
| FR-10 | POST /api/links | com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler | — |

| FR-12 | GET /{code}, GET /api/links/{code}, GET /api/links/{code}/analytics | com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler, com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController, com.example.shortener.api.LinkController | — |
| FR-13 | GET /api/links/{code}/analytics | com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |
| FR-14 | GET /{code} | com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |
| FR-15 | POST /api/links, GET /{code}, GET /api/links/{code}, GET /api/links/{code}/analytics | com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication, com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController | — |

## Dependencies

- org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-parent
- org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-web
- org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-jdbc
- org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc
- org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-test
- org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-maven-plugin

</design>

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: URL Shortener Service with Click Analytics
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Create short links, redirect by short code (302) and read per-link details and click analytics. All operations are public (no authentication).
paths:
  /api/links:
    post:
      operationId: createShortLink
      summary: Create a new short link for an absolute http/https URL (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-15)
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Short link created. A new independent link is created on every call.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: Path of the created link's details resource (/api/links/{code}).
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShortLink'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '415':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /api/links/{code}:
    get:
      operationId: getShortLink
      summary: Get a short link's details (FR-4, FR-11, FR-12, FR-15)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ShortCode'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Short link details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShortLink'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /api/links/{code}/analytics:
    get:
      operationId: getShortLinkAnalytics
      summary: Get a short link's click analytics (FR-7, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ShortCode'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Click analytics for the link
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkAnalytics'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /{code}:
    get:
      operationId: redirectToLongUrl
      summary: Redirect to the original URL and count the click (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ShortCode'
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Temporary redirect to the original long URL. The click is counted.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: The original long URL associated with the short code.
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              description: Always no-store, so every click reaches the service.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: no-store
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
components:
  parameters:
    ShortCode:
      name: code
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Service-generated short code
      schema:
        type: string
        example: aB3xK9q
  schemas:
    CreateLinkRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - url
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          description: Absolute URL with scheme http or https
          example: https://example.com/some/long/path
    ShortLink:
      type: object
      required:
        - shortCode
        - longUrl
        - createdAt
      properties:
        shortCode:
          type: string
          example: aB3xK9q
        longUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: https://example.com/some/long/path
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    LinkAnalytics:
      type: object
      required:
        - shortCode
        - clickCount
      properties:
        shortCode:
          type: string
          example: aB3xK9q
        clickCount:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        lastClickedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: Timestamp of the most recent successful redirect; null if never clicked
    Problem:
      type: object
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          example: about:blank
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Invalid request (missing/malformed body or URL that is not absolute http/https). No short link is created.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    NotFound:
      description: No short link exists for the given short code
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: Request body Content-Type is not application/json
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    InternalError:
      description: Unexpected server error
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'

</openapi>

<schema_sql>
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS short_links (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  short_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  long_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (click_count >= 0),
  last_clicked_at TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_short_links_short_code ON short_links (short_code);

</schema_sql>

<design>
# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

<design>
# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

<design>
# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

## Traceability

| FR-1 | POST /api/links | com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |

<design>
# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

package com.example.shortener.service;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URISyntaxException;
import java.util.Locale;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class UrlValidator {

    private static final String MESSAGE = "url must be an absolute http or https URL";

    public void validate(String url) {
        if (url == null || url.isBlank()) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        URI uri;
        try {
            uri = new URI(url);
        } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        if (!uri.isAbsolute()) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        String scheme = uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!scheme.equals("http") && !scheme.equals("https")) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        String host = uri.getHost();
        if (host == null || host.isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.shortener.persistence;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.RowMapper;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

@Repository
public class ShortLinkRepository {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter FORMAT =
            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS'Z'").withZone(ZoneOffset.UTC);

    private static final RowMapper<ShortLinkRecord> MAPPER = (rs, i) -> {
        String last = rs.getString("last_clicked_at");
        return new ShortLinkRecord(
                rs.getString("short_code"),
                rs.getString("long_url"),
                Instant.parse(rs.getString("created_at")),
                rs.getLong("click_count"),
                last == null ? null : Instant.parse(last));
    };

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public ShortLinkRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
    }

    static String format(Instant instant) {
        return FORMAT.format(instant.truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS));
    }

    /** Inserts a new row; throws DuplicateKeyException on short_code collision. */
    public void insert(String shortCode, String longUrl, Instant createdAt) {
        jdbc.update(
                "INSERT INTO short_links (short_code, long_url, created_at, click_count, last_clicked_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)",
                shortCode, longUrl, format(createdAt));
    }

    public Optional<ShortLinkRecord> findByCode(String shortCode) {
        List<ShortLinkRecord> rows = jdbc.query(
                "SELECT short_code, long_url, created_at, click_count, last_clicked_at FROM short_links WHERE short_code = ?",
                MAPPER, shortCode);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }

    public int incrementClick(String shortCode, Instant now) {
        return jdbc.update(
                "UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ?",
                format(now), shortCode);
    }

    public Optional<String> findLongUrl(String shortCode) {
        List<String> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT long_url FROM short_links WHERE short_code = ?", String.class, shortCode);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }
}

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;

@SpringBootTest
class ShortLinkRepositoryTest {

    private static final Path DB;

    static {
        try {
            DB = Files.createTempFile("shortener-repo-test", ".db");
            DB.toFile().deleteOnExit();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("spring.datasource.url", () -> "jdbc:sqlite:" + DB.toAbsolutePath());
    }

    @Autowired
    ShortLinkRepository repo;

    @Autowired
    JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @BeforeEach
    void clean() {
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM short_links");
    }

    @Test
    void insertAndFind() {
        Instant t = Instant.now().truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS);
        repo.insert("abc1234", "https://example.com/x", t);
        ShortLinkRecord r = repo.findByCode("abc1234").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals("https://example.com/x", r.longUrl());
        assertEquals(t, r.createdAt());
        assertEquals(0, r.clickCount());
        assertNull(r.lastClickedAt());
    }

    @Test
    void duplicateCodeSurfaces() {
        repo.insert("dup1234", "https://a.example", Instant.now());
        assertThrows(DuplicateKeyException.class,
                () -> repo.insert("dup1234", "https://b.example", Instant.now()));
    }

    @Test
    void unknownCodeEmpty() {
        assertTrue(repo.findByCode("nope").isEmpty());
        assertTrue(repo.findLongUrl("nope").isEmpty());
        assertEquals(0, repo.incrementClick("nope", Instant.now()));
    }

    @Test
    void incrementClickCounts() {
        repo.insert("clk1234", "https://example.com", Instant.now());
        Instant now = Instant.now().truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS);
        assertEquals(1, repo.incrementClick("clk1234", now));
        assertEquals(1, repo.incrementClick("clk1234", now));
        ShortLinkRecord r = repo.findByCode("clk1234").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(2, r.clickCount());
        assertEquals(now, r.lastClickedAt());
        assertEquals("https://example.com", repo.findLongUrl("clk1234").orElseThrow());
    }
}

<design>
# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

| FR-1 | POST /api/links | com.example.shortener.api.LinkController, com.example.shortener.service.LinkService, com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator, com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository | — |

package com.example.shortener.service;

import com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRecord;
import com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository;
import java.time.Instant;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class LinkService {

    static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

    private final ShortLinkRepository repository;
    private final UrlValidator validator;
    private final ShortCodeGenerator generator;

    public LinkService(ShortLinkRepository repository, UrlValidator validator, ShortCodeGenerator generator) {
        this.repository = repository;
        this.validator = validator;
        this.generator = generator;
    }

    public ShortLinkRecord create(String url) {
        validator.validate(url);
        Instant createdAt = Instant.now();
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
            String code = generator.generate();
            try {
                repository.insert(code, url, createdAt);
            } catch (DuplicateKeyException e) {
                continue;
            }
            return repository.findByCode(code).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("inserted link not found"));
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException("could not generate a unique short code");
    }

    public ShortLinkRecord getDetails(String code) {
        return repository.findByCode(code).orElseThrow(() -> new LinkNotFoundException(code));
    }

    public ShortLinkRecord getAnalytics(String code) {
        return getDetails(code);
    }

    @Transactional
    public String resolveAndCount(String code) {
        int updated = repository.incrementClick(code, Instant.now());
        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new LinkNotFoundException(code);
        }
        return repository.findLongUrl(code).orElseThrow(() -> new LinkNotFoundException(code));
    }
}

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;

@SpringBootTest
class LinkServiceTest {

    private static final Path DB;

    static {
        try {
            DB = Files.createTempFile("shortener-service-test", ".db");
            DB.toFile().deleteOnExit();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("spring.datasource.url", () -> "jdbc:sqlite:" + DB.toAbsolutePath());
    }

    @Autowired
    LinkService service;

    @Autowired
    JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @BeforeEach
    void clean() {
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM short_links");
    }

    @Test
    void createsIndependentLinks() {
        ShortLinkRecord a = service.create("https://example.com/a");
        ShortLinkRecord b = service.create("https://example.com/a");
        assertNotEquals(a.shortCode(), b.shortCode());
        assertEquals("https://example.com/a", a.longUrl());
        assertNotNull(a.createdAt());
        assertEquals(0, a.clickCount());
    }

    @Test
    void invalidUrlPersistsNothing() {
        assertThrows(InvalidUrlException.class, () -> service.create("ftp://x.com"));
        assertEquals(0, jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM short_links", Integer.class));
    }

    @Test
    void resolveCountsClicks() {
        ShortLinkRecord l = service.create("https://example.com/z");
        assertNull(service.getAnalytics(l.shortCode()).lastClickedAt());
        assertEquals("https://example.com/z", service.resolveAndCount(l.shortCode()));
        service.resolveAndCount(l.shortCode());
        ShortLinkRecord r = service.getAnalytics(l.shortCode());
        assertEquals(2, r.clickCount());
        assertNotNull(r.lastClickedAt());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownCodeThrows() {
        assertThrows(LinkNotFoundException.class, () -> service.resolveAndCount("nope"));
        assertThrows(LinkNotFoundException.class, () -> service.getDetails("nope"));
        assertThrows(LinkNotFoundException.class, () -> service.getAnalytics("nope"));
        assertEquals(0, jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM short_links", Integer.class));
    }
}

# Design

Stack: `java21-springboot3-maven`

## Modules

- **com.example.shortener.ShortenerApplication** — Spring Boot entry point. Configures the SQLite DataSource (jdbc:sqlite file URL, Hikari maximum-pool-size=1 to serialize writes) and runs schema.sql on startup via spring.sql.init.mode=always. Has no authentication or security filter, so every operation is public. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-7, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.LinkController** — REST controller for /api/links. POST /api/links accepts a CreateLinkRequest, delegates to LinkService and returns 201 with a ShortLink body and a Location header. GET /api/links/{code} returns the details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). GET /api/links/{code}/analytics returns clickCount and lastClickedAt, with null when the link has never been clicked. Any client-supplied alias field is ignored. (FR-1, FR-4, FR-7, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.api.RedirectController** — Handles GET /{code}. It calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns 302 Found with a Location header set to the original long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It returns 404 when the code is unknown. (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
- **com.example.shortener.service.LinkService** — Business logic. create: validates the URL, generates a short code, stamps createdAt and inserts a new row on every call with no de-duplication by URL. If the short code collides with an existing one, it retries up to 5 times. getDetails and getAnalytics: look up a link by code and throw LinkNotFoundException if it is absent. resolveAndCount: atomically increments click_count by 1, sets last_clicked_at to the current Instant and returns the long URL. It throws LinkNotFoundException without touching any row when the code is unknown. Every successful redirect counts, with no filtering. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14)
- **com.example.shortener.service.UrlValidator** — Accepts a value only when it parses as an absolute java.net.URI with scheme http or https (case-insensitive) and a non-empty host. Null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values raise InvalidUrlException. (FR-10)
- **com.example.shortener.service.ShortCodeGenerator** — Generates service-owned short codes: 7 random base62 characters [A-Za-z0-9] produced with SecureRandom. (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9)
- **com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — JdbcTemplate data access to the short_links table. Operations: insert (which surfaces DuplicateKeyException on a short_code collision), findByCode, and incrementClick. incrementClick runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ? and returns the affected row count; the long URL is then read in the same transaction. Timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC text with microsecond precision. (FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9, FR-11, FR-12, FR-13)
- **com.example.shortener.api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies containing type, title, status and detail. InvalidUrlException and unreadable or missing bodies map to 400. LinkNotFoundException maps to 404. An unsupported Content-Type maps to 415. Any other exception maps to 500. (FR-10, FR-12)

## Non-functional implementation (from catalog)

- none

## Primary flows

### Create short link (POST /api/links)

1. Client sends POST /api/links with a JSON body {"url": "..."} and no credentials (FR-15).
2. Spring deserializes the body. A missing or malformed body or a wrong Content-Type is handled by ProblemExceptionHandler and returns 400 or 415 as problem+json.
3. UrlValidator checks that the value is an absolute URI with scheme http/https and a host. If not, it throws InvalidUrlException, the handler returns 400 problem+json, and nothing is persisted (FR-10).
4. ShortCodeGenerator produces a random 7-character base62 code. Any client-supplied alias is ignored (FR-8).
5. LinkService sets createdAt = Instant.now() (UTC) and ShortLinkRepository inserts a new row with click_count=0 and last_clicked_at=NULL. There is no lookup by long_url, so each call creates an independent link (FR-9).
6. On a short_code unique violation (DuplicateKeyException), LinkService regenerates the code and retries, up to 5 attempts. If all attempts fail, the request returns 500.
7. The service responds 201 with Location: /api/links/{code} and the body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-1, FR-11).

### Redirect and count click (GET /{code})

1. Client sends GET /{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code).
3. Inside one transaction, ShortLinkRepository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code (FR-5, FR-6, FR-14).
4. If 0 rows are affected, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json. No counter is changed (FR-12).
5. Otherwise the repository SELECTs long_url for the code and the transaction commits.
6. The service responds 302 Found with Location: <long_url>, Cache-Control: no-store and an empty body (FR-2, FR-3).

### Get link details (GET /api/links/{code})

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code} with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getDetails calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt} (FR-4, FR-11).

### Get link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)

1. Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics with no credentials (FR-15).
2. LinkService.getAnalytics calls ShortLinkRepository.findByCode. If no row exists, the handler returns 404 problem+json (FR-12).
3. The service responds 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt}. lastClickedAt is null when last_clicked_at is NULL, so a never-clicked link reports clickCount 0 and lastClickedAt null (FR-7, FR-13).

## Error model

All error responses use Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 7807) with the body {"type": "about:blank", "title": <HTTP reason phrase>, "status": <code>, "detail": <human-readable explanation>}. ProblemExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps exceptions to statuses as follows:
(1) InvalidUrlException becomes 400 Bad Request, with a detail such as "url must be an absolute http or https URL" (FR-10).
(2) HttpMessageNotReadableException (malformed or missing JSON body) and a missing or blank url field also become 400 Bad Request (FR-10).
(3) HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException becomes 415 Unsupported Media Type.
(4) LinkNotFoundException becomes 404 Not Found, with the detail "No short link exists for code '<code>'", on the redirect, details and analytics endpoints (FR-12).
(5) Any other uncaught exception, including exhausted short-code collision retries or a database failure, becomes 500 Internal Server Error with a generic detail; stack traces are logged, never returned.
No error path creates a link or modifies click counters: create validation runs before insert, and the redirect returns 404 when the UPDATE affects 0 rows. The service never returns 401 or 403 because there is no authentication (FR-15).

import com.example.shortener.service.InvalidUrlException;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatusCode;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ProblemDetail;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
import org.springframework.web.ErrorResponse;
import org.springframework.web.HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class ProblemExceptionHandler {

    private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ProblemExceptionHandler.class);

    @ExceptionHandler(InvalidUrlException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> invalidUrl(InvalidUrlException e) {
        return build(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "url must be an absolute http or https URL");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(HttpMessageNotReadableException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> unreadable(HttpMessageNotReadableException e) {
        return build(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "request body is missing or malformed");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> unsupported(HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException e) {
        return build(HttpStatus.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, "Content-Type must be application/json");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(LinkNotFoundException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> notFound(LinkNotFoundException e) {
        return build(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> other(Exception e) {
        if (e instanceof ErrorResponse er) {
            HttpStatusCode sc = er.getStatusCode();
            HttpStatus hs = HttpStatus.resolve(sc.value());
            if (hs != null) {
                return build(hs, hs.getReasonPhrase());
            }
        }
        LOG.error("Unhandled exception", e);
        return build(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "an unexpected error occurred");
    }

    private static ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> build(HttpStatus status, String detail) {
        ProblemDetail pd = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(status, detail);
        pd.setTitle(status.getReasonPhrase());
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON).body(pd);
    }
}

package com.example.shortener.persistence;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.RowMapper;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

@Repository
public class ShortLinkRepository {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter FORMAT =
            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS'Z'").withZone(ZoneOffset.UTC);

    private static final RowMapper<ShortLinkRecord> MAPPER = (rs, i) -> {
        String last = rs.getString("last_clicked_at");
        return new ShortLinkRecord(
                rs.getString("short_code"),
                rs.getString("long_url"),
                Instant.parse(rs.getString("created_at")),
                rs.getLong("click_count"),
                last == null ? null : Instant.parse(last));
    };

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public ShortLinkRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
    }

    static String format(Instant instant) {
        return FORMAT.format(instant.truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS));
    }

    /** Inserts a new row; throws DuplicateKeyException on short_code collision. */
    public void insert(String shortCode, String longUrl, Instant createdAt) {
        jdbc.update(
                "INSERT INTO short_links (short_code, long_url, created_at, click_count, last_clicked_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)",
                shortCode, longUrl, format(createdAt));
    }

    public Optional<ShortLinkRecord> findByCode(String shortCode) {
        List<ShortLinkRecord> rows = jdbc.query(
                "SELECT short_code, long_url, created_at, click_count, last_clicked_at FROM short_links WHERE short_code = ?",
                MAPPER, shortCode);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }

    public int incrementClick(String shortCode, Instant now) {
        return jdbc.update(
                "UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE short_code = ?",
                format(now), shortCode);
    }

    public Optional<String> findLongUrl(String shortCode) {
        List<String> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT long_url FROM short_links WHERE short_code = ?", String.class, shortCode);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }
}

package com.example.shortener.service;

import com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRecord;
import com.example.shortener.persistence.ShortLinkRepository;
import java.time.Instant;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class LinkService {

    static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

    private final ShortLinkRepository repository;
    private final UrlValidator validator;
    private final ShortCodeGenerator generator;

    public LinkService(ShortLinkRepository repository, UrlValidator validator, ShortCodeGenerator generator) {
        this.repository = repository;
        this.validator = validator;
        this.generator = generator;
    }

    public ShortLinkRecord create(String url) {
        validator.validate(url);
        Instant createdAt = Instant.now();
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
            String code = generator.generate();
            try {
                repository.insert(code, url, createdAt);
            } catch (DuplicateKeyException e) {
                continue;
            }
            return repository.findByCode(code).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("inserted link not found"));
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException("could not generate a unique short code");
    }

    public ShortLinkRecord getDetails(String code) {
        return repository.findByCode(code).orElseThrow(() -> new LinkNotFoundException(code));
    }

    public ShortLinkRecord getAnalytics(String code) {
        return getDetails(code);
    }

    @Transactional
    public String resolveAndCount(String code) {
        int updated = repository.incrementClick(code, Instant.now());
        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new LinkNotFoundException(code);
        }
        return repository.findLongUrl(code).orElseThrow(() -> new LinkNotFoundException(code));
    }
}

package com.example.shortener.service;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URISyntaxException;
import java.util.Locale;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class UrlValidator {

    private static final String MESSAGE = "url must be an absolute http or https URL";

    public void validate(String url) {
        if (url == null || url.isBlank()) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        URI uri;
        try {
            uri = new URI(url);
        } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        if (!uri.isAbsolute()) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        String scheme = uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!scheme.equals("http") && !scheme.equals("https")) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
        String host = uri.getHost();
        if (host == null || host.isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidUrlException(MESSAGE);
        }
    }
}
